{{Short description|International football club competition in Europe}} {{EngvarB|date=August 2025}} {{Use dmy dates|date=August 2025}} The '''2025–26 UEFA Conference League league phase''' began on 2 October and ended on 18 December 2025. A total of 36 teams competed in the league phase to decide the 24 places in the [[2025–26 UEFA Conference League knockout phase|knockout phase]] of the [[2025–26 UEFA Conference League]]. [[Crystal Palace F.C.|Crystal Palace]], [[FC Drita|Drita]], [[Hamrun Spartans F.C.|Hamrun Spartans]], [[Kuopion Palloseura|KuPS]], [[Rayo Vallecano]], [[Samsunspor]], [[Shelbourne F.C.|Shelbourne]], [[KF Shkëndija|Shkëndija]], [[SK Sigma Olomouc|Sigma Olomouc]] and [[CS Universitatea Craiova|Universitatea Craiova]] made their debut appearances in a major UEFA competition group or league phase. Hamrun Spartans was the first team from Malta to play in a major UEFA competition group stage or league phase.{{cite web |date=28 August 2025 |title=Ħamrun Spartans make history as first Maltese team to reach UEFA league phase |url=https://timesofmalta.com/article/hamrun-spartans-make-history-first-maltese-team-uefa-league-phase.1115363 |access-date=28 August 2025 |website=Times of Malta}} A total of 29 national associations were represented in the league phase. Poland was the first country to have four clubs play in the Conference League group stage/league phase, and it was also the first time in history that four Polish clubs competed in any edition of a UEFA competition group stage or league phase. ==Format== Each team played six matches, three at home and three away, against six different opponents, with all 36 teams ranked in a single league table. Teams were separated into six pots based on their [[UEFA coefficient#Men's club coefficient|2025 UEFA club coefficients]], and each team played one team from each of the six pots. The top eight teams in the standings received a [[Bye (sports)|bye]] to the round of 16. The teams ranked from 9th to 24th contested the knockout phase play-offs, with the teams ranked from 9th to 16th seeded for the draw. Teams ranked from 25th to 36th were eliminated from European competition. ===Tiebreakers=== Teams were ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, 0 points for a loss). If two or more teams were equal on points upon completion of the league phase, the following tiebreaking criteria were applied, in the order given, to determine their rankings:{{cite web |url=https://documents.uefa.com/r/Regulations-of-the-UEFA-Conference-League-2025/26-Online |title=Regulations of the UEFA Conference League – 2025/26 Season |publisher=[[UEFA]] |date=27 June 2025 |access-date=27 August 2025 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250911174042/https://documents.uefa.com/api/khub/maps/lF5ByLxUQ80KExi2jpZBUw/attachments/hNUmn2jBcBnQU7XzDPWCOw-lF5ByLxUQ80KExi2jpZBUw/content |archive-date=11 September 2025}} While the league phase was in progress, teams were ranked according to criteria 1–5 only, and if still tied, were given equal ranking and sorted alphabetically. August 2025}} The automated draw software instantly conducted the full digital draw at random, determining the home and away matches for all clubs. Each team faced one opponent from each of the six pots, three of which they faced at home and three away. For the purposes of determining match venues, adjacent pots were paired (Pot 1 with 2, 3 with 4, and 5 with 6) so that, for each pot pairing, teams would face one opponent at home and one away. Teams could not face opponents from their own association, and could only be drawn against a maximum of two sides from the same association. For political reasons, clubs from [[Status of Gibraltar|Gibraltar–Spain]] and [[Bosnia and Herzegovina–Kosovo relations|Kosovo–Bosnia and Herzegovina]] could not be drawn against each other. The draw results were then revealed pot-by-pot, starting with Pot 1, with the intention of "maintaining suspense and clarity for viewers".
